Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

give me five! phrase

also high five, high-five, gimme five

* our formation

* (our own formation) Cedo palmam!

give me five! (holding up a hand to be slapped)

No ancient form is known: the high five is modern. Ours, on the model of Plautus’s Cedo manum, give me your hand (Capt. 838, 859; see give it here), with palma, the flat of the hand (Cic., Verg.).

Examples

  • Euge! Cedo palmam!

    Well done! Give me five!composed

See also give it here!, clap, bravo, hand, five.

SourcesLewis & Short: cedo · Lewis & Short: palma
